import time, subprocess, sys

# Edge case test (ties, case, punctuation, digits)
edge_in = b"Apple banana! APPLE, cherry123banana; cherry\n"

if edge_out != "apple 2\nbanana 2\ncherry 2\n":
    print(0)

with open("expected.txt", "rb") as f:
    exp = f.read()

t0 = time.perf_counter()
with open("data.txt", "rb") as fin:
    out = subprocess.check_output(["python3", "wf.py"], stdin=fin)
t1 = time.perf_counter()

if out != exp:
    print(0)
else:
    print(f"{20.0 / (t1 - t0):.2f}")
